name: 04_zero_quarters
description: Year-to-date method: S1 has a whole year of income below θ (four zero payments), then a year that crosses θ in Q3 (payments only for the increments); S2 settles mid-year (April) and its first report carries an attested prior commitment for the income earned before settlement (90,000 > θ), so only the increment is charged; plus proof/attestation reverts (tampered public signal, wrong prior commitment, wrong key type, disabled tier).

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: the first expected period is Q2, the quarter of settlement
first report of a mid-year series: prior = Poseidon(2)(90,000e6, salt) attested with the report (§6.2 step 5); owed(150,000) − owed(90,000) = 2,800 − 400 = 2,400
the 400 owed on pre-settlement income is never charged
chained prior = Q2's income commitment: owed 4,800 − 2,800 = 2,000
four zero reports: lastPaidPeriod 8107, nothing ever owed, vault 0, status OnTime
honest proof for 800, claimed payment 0 → the public signal does not verify
prior commitment must chain to Q2's income commitment
tier 2 needs a report-verifier key, not an attestor
first real payment in Q3 2027: 800 gross, 40 fee, 760 net
2027 total 2,400 = 4% × (140,000 − 80,000); each holder received 570 USDC net
